# First-party translation units the Linux `host-full-nogen` preset does not compile, so the
# `tidy` job has no compile command for them. A changed .c/.cpp that is neither
# in build/host-full-nogen/compile_commands.json nor listed here fails the job,
# which keeps gaps in tidy coverage visible. Remove an entry once its translation
# unit builds in that preset.
# Paths are repo-relative, one per line, exact match.
